meta.config: ABLATION: 4-screw joints but no joint gussets near the lift points

R1_rigid.label: Rigid lifting frame, 8 slings of exact equal length and no stretch

R4_equalised.label: Equalising rig (beam cascade): four equal sling forces on each side, sides by statics

T1_roll_S.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module rolls down to the south by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

T2_roll_N.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module rolls down to the north by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

T3_pitch_W.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module pitches down at the west end by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

T4_pitch_E.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module pitches down at the east end by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

T5_SW.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module tilts down to the south-west by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

T6_SE.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module tilts down to the south-east by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

T7_NW.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module tilts down to the north-west by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

T8_NE.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module tilts down to the north-east by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module)

L1_squeeze_y.label: Equalising rig, slings lean in across the module (3.5 % of the larger drop force on each beam, equal and opposite)

L2_spread_y.label: Equalising rig, slings lean out across the module (3.5 % of the larger drop force on each beam, equal and opposite)

L3_squeeze_x.label: Equalising rig, slings lean in along the module (3.5 % of the larger drop force on each beam, equal and opposite)

L4_spread_x.label: Equalising rig, slings lean out along the module (3.5 % of the larger drop force on each beam, equal and opposite)

T1+L1.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module rolls down to the south by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean in across the module

T1+L2.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module rolls down to the south by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean out across the module

T1+L3.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module rolls down to the south by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean in along the module

T1+L4.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module rolls down to the south by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean out along the module

T2+L1.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module rolls down to the north by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean in across the module

T2+L2.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module rolls down to the north by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean out across the module

T2+L3.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module rolls down to the north by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean in along the module

T2+L4.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module rolls down to the north by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean out along the module

T3+L1.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module pitches down at the west end by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean in across the module

T3+L2.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module pitches down at the west end by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean out across the module

T3+L3.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module pitches down at the west end by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean in along the module

T3+L4.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module pitches down at the west end by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean out along the module

T4+L1.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module pitches down at the east end by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean in across the module

T4+L2.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module pitches down at the east end by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean out across the module

T4+L3.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module pitches down at the east end by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean in along the module

T4+L4.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module pitches down at the east end by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean out along the module

T5+L1.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module tilts down to the south-west by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean in across the module

T5+L2.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module tilts down to the south-west by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean out across the module

T6+L1.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module tilts down to the south-east by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean in across the module

T6+L2.label: Cascade picks off the CoG: module tilts down to the south-east by 2 deg (net sideways load on the module) - and slings lean out across the module

TW1_twist.label: Cascade cross beams set 25 mm off their own lines' split in opposite senses (west cross beams set south, east cross beams set north): the module twists

TW2_twist.label: Cascade cross beams set 25 mm off their own lines' split in opposite senses (west cross beams set north, east cross beams set south): the module twists

CG_NE.label: Centre of gravity 150 mm along and 90 mm across off the design position (NE), cascade set to it

CG_NE+T.label: Centre of gravity at the NE corner and the module hanging 2 deg toward it

CG_NW.label: Centre of gravity 150 mm along and 90 mm across off the design position (NW), cascade set to it

CG_NW+T.label: Centre of gravity at the NW corner and the module hanging 2 deg toward it

CG_SE.label: Centre of gravity 150 mm along and 90 mm across off the design position (SE), cascade set to it

CG_SE+T.label: Centre of gravity at the SE corner and the module hanging 2 deg toward it

CG_SW.label: Centre of gravity 150 mm along and 90 mm across off the design position (SW), cascade set to it

CG_SW+T.label: Centre of gravity at the SW corner and the module hanging 2 deg toward it
